verdict.rationale: W&B ships its own MCP server and Skills so AI assistants can answer natural-language questions about Weave runs, traces, evaluations and artifacts. Marketing also claims coding agents like Claude Code can run evaluations and iteration loops through them. Natural-language operation therefore works only through an external agent client, and the action-taking side rests on marketing claims rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, detailed docs on which actions (not just queries) the MCP server can execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
